newsitem.title: FINLAND: ERM link, before forestry reports, stumps Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: ERM link, before forestry reports, stumps Helsinki.

text.p: Shares ended a slow first day with the markka in ERM mixed and at a loss for direction on Monday as the link, seen on the bearish side for forestries, came days before interim results from the sector.
The HEX index rose 0.23 percent 2,189.95, but volume was very thin at 242 million markka.

"I'm desperate, but I'm not busy," said one broker, asked if he had time to comment on late trade. Another said there was buying interest, but without confidence; and at the same time reported only light selling interest in forestries.

Bonds gained and the markka steadied, but with eight-month results due from forestry majors UPM-Kymmene and Metsa-Serla on Thursday widely expected to be weak, brokers were left drumming their fingers.
Forestries were slack but ended off earlier lows, with UPM-Kymmene down one markka or just over one percent at 93.50 while Metsa-Serla put on 0.20 to close at 28.80 markka.

Brokers said there had been little overseas interest in Finnish stocks, although analysts said the ERM link should in the long term open upside for Helsinki, lifting valuations closer into line with other European bourses.
"It's pretty obvious it won't happen overnight," said one.

Otherwise Amer chalked up gains as it said it would sell its troubled MacGregor golf unit; and builder YIT was very strong after a sharp upturn in eight-month profit and a proposed share redemption clause.
